newsitem.title: FRANCE: TF1 shares drop ahead of meetings.
newsitem.headline: TF1 shares drop ahead of meetings.

text.p: Shares in French television company TF1 shed up to 3.8 percent on the Paris bourse on Wednesday, dipping to a low of 556 francs, ahead of meetings the company is holding at 1100 GMT with journalists and at 1430 GMT with analysts, media share analysts said.
They said they expected the private TV channel's profits to fall further in 1997 after 1996's 4.5 percent slide in net attributable profit to 575 million francs.
The stock was four francs lower at 574 francs at 0959 GMT in volume of 7,835 shares.
"I am expecting a fall of 10 percent (in net attributable profit) in 1997, a year in which investments in the digital service TPS will continue to weigh," said one analyst.
He added that TF1 will also have to deal with a diminishing audience.
Another analyst said TF1 was having difficulty with its prime time programmes.
